- [Get a purchase](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/purchases/get-a-purchase.md): Returns a single purchase's details: `transaction_id`, `status`, `source`, the buyer's `email_address` and `subscriber_id`, monetary breakdown (`subtotal`, `discount`, `tax`, `total`, `currency`), `transaction_time`, and the purchased `products` with quantities and unit prices.
- [List segments](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/segments/list-segments.md): Returns a cursor-paginated list of all segments in the account with their `id`, `name`, and creation date.

- [Get a sequence](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/sequences/get-a-sequence.md): Fetches a single sequence by `id`. - [Delete a sequence](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/sequences/delete-a-sequence.md): Soft-deletes a sequence. The sequence is removed from active delivery immediately, with cleanup of associated state happening in the background.

- [Update a snippet](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/snippets/update-a-snippet.md): Rename a snippet, replace its body, or archive/restore it. - [List webhook endpoints](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks/list-webhook-endpoints.md): Returns a paginated list of the account's webhook endpoints. Filter with `status` to return only `active` or `disabled` endpoints.
- [Create a webhook endpoint](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks/create-a-webhook-endpoint.md): Registers a URL to receive deliveries for the [event types](/webhooks/event-types) listed in `events`. The `url` must be publicly reachable over HTTP(S) — private, internal, and loopback addresses are rejected.
- [Get a webhook endpoint](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks/get-a-webhook-endpoint.md): Returns a single webhook endpoint. The signing `secret` is never included — it's only returned when you [create the endpoint](/api-reference/webhooks/create-a-webhook-endpoint) or [rotate the secret](/api-reference/webhooks/rotate-a-webhook-endpoint-secret).
- [Delete a webhook endpoint](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks/delete-a-webhook-endpoint.md): Deletes the webhook endpoint and stops all future deliveries of its subscribed events. Returns `204 No Content` on success and `404` when the id doesn't exist or isn't visible to the caller.
- [Update a webhook endpoint](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks/update-a-webhook-endpoint.md): Updates any of `name`, `url`, `description`, `status`, and `events`. Set `status` to `disabled` to stop deliveries without deleting the endpoint, and back to `active` to resume.
- [List webhook deliveries](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks/list-webhook-deliveries.md): Returns a paginated list of deliveries for a webhook endpoint. Delivery history is retained for 30 days — older records are automatically removed.
- [Get webhook delivery details](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks/get-webhook-delivery-details.md): Returns a single delivery record including its full attempt history — timestamps, HTTP status codes, and response bodies. Pass `include_payload=true` to also return the events that were sent.
- [Revoke the previous webhook endpoint secret](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks/revoke-the-previous-webhook-endpoint-secret.md): Closes a [rotation's](/api-reference/webhooks/rotate-a-webhook-endpoint-secret) overlap window early: the previous secret stops verifying immediately, leaving only the current secret valid. Call this once you've fully switched to the new secret, rather than waiting for `previous_secret_expires_at` t…
- [Rotate a webhook endpoint secret](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks/rotate-a-webhook-endpoint-secret.md): Generates a new signing secret for the endpoint and returns it. **The response is the only time the new `secret` appears in plaintext** — store it securely.
- [List webhooks](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks-legacy/list-webhooks.md): **Legacy:** This is the previous generation of Kit webhooks. It keeps working and there are no plans to remove it, but it's superseded by [webhook endpoints](/api-reference/webhooks/list-webhook-endpoints), which support many event types per endpoint, signed deliveries, and automatic retries — use t…
- [Create a webhook](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks-legacy/create-a-webhook.md): **Legacy:** This creates a previous-generation webhook. Existing webhooks keep working and there are no plans to remove them, but new integrations should use [Create a webhook endpoint](/api-reference/webhooks/create-a-webhook-endpoint) instead — one endpoint subscribes to many event types and gets…
- [Delete a webhook](https://developers.kit.com/api-reference/webhooks-legacy/delete-a-webhook.md): **Legacy:** This deletes a previous-generation webhook. If you're replacing it rather than retiring it, consider recreating it as a [webhook endpoint](/api-reference/webhooks/create-a-webhook-endpoint) — see the [webhooks guides](/webhooks/overview).
